versions.changelog:
- Adds a note in the description clarifying that on first run the skill will auto-manage DashScope API Keys (create/recycle) and may auto-install the Alibaba Cloud CLI ModelStudio plugin.
- No other significant changes; all core security, API usage, and orchestration logic remain unchanged.

Initial release of AI voice creation skill for speech recognition and text-to-speech on Alibaba Cloud.

- Supports long and short audio speech recognition (ASR) with emotion detection, timestamps, and multiple languages.
- Enables high-quality text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis with flexible voice control, using only qwen-tts via DashScope.
- Enforces strict security and execution policies, including safe API key management and no fallback to unofficial services.
- Provides orchestration for automatic model and API choice based on user input and audio properties.
- Includes clear error handling and user guidance for setup and failure cases.
